scripts.android:build: cd flutter_app && if [ ! -f firebase-options.json ]; then echo 'Missing flutter_app/firebase-options.json; copy the example and add your Firebase values.'; exit 1; fi && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --dart-define-from-file=firebase-options.json
scripts.android:build:debug: cd flutter_app && if [ ! -f firebase-options.json ]; then echo 'Missing flutter_app/firebase-options.json; copy the example and add your Firebase values.'; exit 1; fi && flutter build apk --debug --dart-define-from-file=firebase-options.json
